_note: Which checks ops/ci.sh runs where, and WHY each exception exists. Read by the gates class. Every entry needs a reason, and ci.sh PRINTS every exception on every run — a check that stops running must never do so quietly. That is the failure shape of the runaway launchd job found 2026-08-13: a clean report that was clean because nothing was looking.

local_only.reason: Exercises drift detection against the Google Drive vault, which exists only on Joe's Mac. A Linux runner has no vault to drift.

quarantined.reason: FLAKY, not failing.
